catholic-encyclopedia-1913-achaz: A 1913 entry on Achaz — Ahaz, the faithless king of Judah. Anthony Maas recounts his Assyrian bargain. Isaiah's sign went unheeded by him. A king who chose fear over faith. He sacrificed his own son in the valley. Judah never sank lower.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alvarez-de-pa: This 1913 reference article on Alvarez de Paz — the Jesuit mystic of Peru. Thomas Campbell praises his spiritual works. His prayer lit the Andes missions. The schools still read his counsels. A contemplative among the conquistadors' heirs. His De vita spirituali guides the fervent.
